verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's declarative model acts on many resources in one run. It builds a graph of all resources and creates or modifies non-dependent ones in parallel. Destroy mode targets all remote objects at once, for_each generates provider configurations in bulk, a single variable change can update all modules, and `-exclude` scopes which resources an operation touches. Community comments also note for_each support on import blocks. missing for 10: first-party docs on resource-level for_each/count for bulk definition, documented bulk-import mechanics, independent hands-on evidence of large-scale bulk runs.
